name: fireworks
description: Launches a 3D voxel fireworks particle display inside the live Block Garden world.

count.description: Number of fireworks bursts to ignite (default: 5).

colorPalette.description: Color theme for particle explosions: rainbow, gold, neon, emerald.

execution.code: const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-commands'); const res = new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-results'); const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { const t = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('Timed out — game may not be loaded yet.'); }, 12000); res.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.requestId === requestId) { clearTimeout(t); res.close(); resolve(e.data.result); } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'blockgarden:fireworks', requestId }); cmd.close(); }); return result;
